title: Interview of the C-130 pilot in Bozeman for True Legends

tellings.quote: we flew him out to Boseman, Montana, and we interviewed him, Steve and I.

plain: Sometime in the 2010s, Tim Alberino says, he and a man named Steve Quayle flew a pilot of a C-130, the military cargo plane, out to Bozeman, Montana, and interviewed him for their production True Legends. Alberino tells Michels this himself, in an episode about a twelve-foot giant he claims was captured in Afghanistan; he does not say here what the pilot told them.
